domain_capabilities.description: Resolve general ecommerce service objectives using available evidence.
Resolve product questions using catalog, media and knowledge evidence; do not assume a product category.
Resolve order and logistics questions using current business records.
Resolve billing and after-sales requests using current records and policy evidence; distinguish returns, exchanges and refunds and only perform available actions.
Assess account security concerns; distinguish user reports from verified facts.
Resolve support case objectives using verified case records.

goal_descriptions.cancel_active_work: Cancel one active conversation objective using its revises_control_id; this does not cancel an order.
goal_descriptions.cancel_order: Prepare cancellation of a specific order when the user requests that action; requires a bound order_id. Policy questions use general_qa.
goal_descriptions.change_address: Prepare an actual shipping-address change requested by the user; requires a bound order_id and explicitly supplied new_address. Questions about whether or how changes work use general_qa.
goal_descriptions.continue_active_work: Continue an unchanged objective listed in resumable_work using its control_id as revises_control_id. An active control alone is not a resume entry. The runtime restores accepted tools and arguments; do not reconstruct them. Pending approval still requires an approval decision. For a changed scope use delegate_task with revises_control_id instead.
goal_descriptions.delegate_task: Delegate an open objective to a registered domain using target_agent and objective. The domain chooses its available tools; this does not authorize an unavailable action.
goal_descriptions.execute_refund: Prepare a refund action explicitly requested for a specific order; requires a bound order_id. General refund rules use refund_policy.
goal_descriptions.freeze_account: Prepare an account freeze explicitly requested by the user; does not merely explain account security rules.
goal_descriptions.general_qa: Retrieve policy or FAQ evidence, including shipping, address-change rules, coupons and general procedures; performs no business action.
goal_descriptions.invoice_qa: Retrieve invoice rules and procedures; does not issue or modify an invoice.
goal_descriptions.logistics_status: Read shipping status from a specific order record; requires a bound order_id and does not fetch carrier tracking events.
goal_descriptions.media_text_read: Read text/OCR from a supplied media asset; requires a bound asset_id.
goal_descriptions.media_visual_analysis: Analyze visual appearance, regions, layout or controls of a supplied asset; requires a bound asset_id.
goal_descriptions.order_status: Read a specific order's current record; requires a bound order_id.
goal_descriptions.product_assistance: Identify a product from a supplied media asset and retrieve related knowledge using domain tools and skills; requires a bound asset_id. Text-only documentation questions use product_qa.
goal_descriptions.product_identification: Identify a product from a supplied media asset using registered identification capabilities; requires a bound asset_id. Text-only documentation questions use product_qa.
goal_descriptions.product_qa: Retrieve product documentation or knowledge evidence for product rules, compatibility requirements and safe-use questions. Can retrieve rules about unknown prerequisites without identifying a physical product; does not require an asset_id. Actual media identification uses product_identification.
goal_descriptions.refund_eligibility: Read a specific order's operational refund-submission precheck (order status, configured submission window, existing application); requires a bound order_id. Does not assess gift, product-exception or refund-amount policies. Pair with refund_policy when those rules are also requested.
goal_descriptions.refund_policy: Retrieve return/refund rules, after-sales conditions and the meaning of policy stages, including questions applied to a known order. An order reference does not turn a policy question into a business-state lookup. No order ID is required and no refund is started.
goal_descriptions.refund_status: Read an existing order's current refund progress; requires a bound order_id. Explaining whether one approval stage implies another outcome requires refund_policy evidence; a progress read alone does not establish that rule.
goal_descriptions.security_review: Read recent account security events; does not freeze the account.
